roleContext.jobDescription: Elmridge Credit Union serves teachers and public-sector workers across the state. The Product Owner for savings and deposits runs the online-banking backlog for savings features, works with the core-banking vendor and the compliance officer on rate and disclosure changes, and leads releases into production with the change advisory board, followed by a post-launch review. The role includes member research and a quarterly report to the product committee. The digital team has eight engineers and a designer, the core platform is run by an external vendor under a service agreement, and members use the online and mobile channels for nearly all savings activity.

requirements.text: Leads member research and translates findings into backlog items.
Coordinates delivery with the core-banking vendor and internal engineering.
Has led a savings or deposit feature through production release with change-board approval and a post-launch review.
Ensures rate and disclosure changes are reviewed by compliance before release.
Reports feature results to a product committee each quarter.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Product Owner, Savings and Deposits

## Experience

- Product Owner, Northgate Federal Credit Union (May 2020 to June 2024). Interviewed 22 members about saving towards goals and turned the recurring themes into backlog items for a round-up savings feature, ordered by how often each theme came up.
- Coordinated sprint planning between the online-banking team and the core-banking vendor's integration engineers through a shared dependency log reviewed each week, and escalated two vendor delays to the vendor's account manager.
- Led the production release of round-up savings on 15 April 2023, five days after change advisory board approval; before that, the feature ran as a member-panel pilot with 300 volunteers in the UAT environment.
- Sent every rate-sheet and disclosure update to the compliance officer for review before scheduling it, and filed the approval emails with the release record.
- Wrote the savings section of the quarterly digital report, which the head of digital presented to the product committee.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the post-launch review for round-up savings, with change advisory board reference CAB-0419, the production release date of 15 April 2023, enrolment counts for the first 90 days taken from the core-banking reports, and the defects raised after launch with the date each was fixed.
